items.verdict: story flavour only, no mechanical effect, so you will never actually wear it
advantage on attacks and disadvantage against you, but ONLY versus aberrations; swap in for those fights
self-only Aid that does not stack with the real spell; five early hit points at best
one bonus-action vulnerability per long rest; big burst on a chosen attack, otherwise ignorable
patches a build with no access to the game's best repositioning tool
1d8 heal that can put your own ally to sleep; unusable in combat
resource-free lesser restoration per short rest; also clears Astarion's bloodless condition
permanent slashing resistance is strong, but bludgeoning vulnerability can pop you; only for vetted encounters
animal friendship is an extremely weak spell with no situation in the game that wants it
free 1d6 poison weapon coating on any heal; easy extra damage all game
+2 intimidation once per long rest; the least useful Charisma skill, and it costs an action
+2 persuasion once per long rest; the right check can skip a very hard fight
dancing lights at will; free light source, and the orbs block poison vents
no opportunity attacks below half health; available early, so somebody always wears it
spellcasting modifier added to elemental cantrips; excellent for Ray of Frost builds and infrequent resters
restores a spell slot up to third level; a mainstay for casters all game
maximises healing received; good for heal-heavy parties and stretching potions, otherwise minor
magic missile once per long rest plus an extra missile; guarantees kills for any party
shatter and ki restoration; mainly for monks and for breaking scrying orbs out of combat

unassigned.why: a blanket verdict on every non-magical amulet in the game (plain lockets, necklaces, pendants, charms), not on one named item
